sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Colour: head and antennae hazel-brown, nasus and anterior half of the pronotum chestnut-brown, the rest of the thorax and the abdominal tergites buckthorn-brown, legs slightly paler. Head of medium length and width, rather thick (high), widest in the posterior 1/3, hardly narrowing towards the base of the nasus; posterior half hemisphere-shaped in dorsal view; covered with many rather short stout red bristles; nasus slightly shorter than 1/3 of the total head length, broad at the base. Antennae 13 or 14-segmented: segment 1 twice as long as wide and cylindrical; segment 2 half of segment 1, slightly narrower at the base; segment 3 equal to segment 2 but narrower; segments 4—6 equal in length and longer than segments 2 and 3 (or segments 3 and 4 closely fused, giving 13 segments in appearance, with segment 2 the shortest); segments 7—10 long and narrow, longer than segment 6; segments 11—13 slightly shorter than segments 7—10; segment 14 equal to segment 13, widest in the middle and bluntly rounded at the tip. Pronotum small, the anterior half abruptly upturned, narrowed and deeply concave in the middle, the anterolateral angles narrowed, the lateral margins sloping down obliquely towards the indistinct posterior margin, the surface with bristles of medium density as on the abdomen. Legs of medium length and stout, with many bristles. Measurements: body length 3.50—4.50 mm; head length 1.60—1.70 mm; head width 1.08 mm; head height 0.74 mm; antennal length 1.80 mm; pronotum length 0.25—0.28 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: The original was published as Eutermes olidus, n. sp., with specimens from islands of the South Pacific and Torres Strait.
